                                        (map (lambda (c) (list r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (best #f))
             (define (segment? c r0 r1)
               (and
                 (!= (at g r0 c) 0)
                 (= (at g r0 c) (at g r1 c))
                 (all? (lambda (r) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range r0 (+ r1 1)))))
             (define (guide-cell? p r0 r1 cL cR)
               (and (>= (fst p) r0) (<= (fst p) r1) (or (= (snd p) cL) (= (snd p) cR))))

               (filter (lambda (p)
                         (and
                           (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)
                           (not (guide-cell? p r0 r1 cL cR))))
                       all-cells))

               (let* ((oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                      (ow (+ 1 (- cR cL)))
                      (cells (pat-cells r0 r1 cL cR)))
                 (unless
                   (empty? cells)
                   (let* ((pr0 (min-of fst cells))
                          (pr1 (max-of fst cells))
                          (pc0 (min-of snd cells))
                          (pc1 (max-of snd cells)))
                     (when
                       (and
                         (= (+ 1 (- pr1 pr0)) (- oh 2))
                         (= (+ 1 (- pc1 pc0)) (- ow 2)))
                       (set! best (list r0 r1 cL cR pr0 pr1 pc0 pc1)))))))

                     (cA (range 0 w))
                     (cB (range (+ cA 1) w)))
                   (when
                     (and (not best) (segment? cA r0 r1) (segment? cB r0 r1))
                     (try-pair r0 r1 cA cB)))
             (let* ((r0 (first best))
                    (r1 (second best))
                    (cL (third best))
                    (cR (fourth best))
                    (pr0 (fifth best))
                    (pc0 (seventh best))
                    (pc1 (eighth best))
                    (oh (+ 1 (- r1 r0)))
                    (ow (+ 1 (- cR cL)))
                    (ih (- oh 2))
                    (iw (- ow 2))
                    (left (at g (+ r0 1) cL))

                                        (map (lambda (dc) (list dr dc)) (range 0 iw)))

                 (let ((dr (fst off))

                   (at g (+ pr0 dr) (if flip? (- pc1 dc) (+ pc0 dc)))))
